title: THE TITLE STEP CARDS ARE SOLID
why: Seen on the 4K title screenshot of 2026-10-07: v18.67 made the mode rows solid, but the three step cards above them (ASCEND, PILLAGE, EXTRACT) were still see-through, so characters walking the Undercroft behind the title showed inside them. They have the same dark fill now; the words are unchanged.
now: The three step cards on the title are solid.

edits.replacement: background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(30,38,72,.92),rgba(9,13,28,.92)); box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06); }   /* v16.xx, seen on the 4K title screenshot (2026-10-07): the Undercroft behind the title showed through the three step cards, a head inside 2 PILLAGE; solid like the mode rows (v18.67) */
